create_viewer_instance: create a Viewer instance with a viewport, mouse, and keyboard to display a MuJoCo physics world
initialize_viewer_with_physics: initialize the Viewer with a physics instance, renderer, and touchpad flag to bind input controls
render_viewer_scene: render the current physics scene through the Viewer camera and renderer pipeline
cycle_camera_selector: use CameraSelector to cycle between fixed scene cameras and free camera mode in the viewer
manipulate_object_with_controller: use ManipulationController to select, translate, and rotate bodies in the MuJoCo scene via mouse input
